name: Pune outreach v2 (draft, approve, send, follow up)

parameters.content:
## Pune outreach v2: START HERE
1. Replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID` in every Google Sheets node (or open one node, pick your sheet, then copy to the rest).
2. Attach credentials: Google Sheets, Gmail, and a Header Auth credential (name `x-api-key`, value = your Anthropic API key) on the two Claude nodes.
3. Run each flow once with its **Manual run** trigger using a test row before activating.
4. Activate the workflow. Full guide: README_run_outreach.md

Daily caps live in the 'Guard' code nodes (CAP). Start at 10.

## FLOW A: DRAFT
Weekdays 09:00 IST. Takes the first 10 rows with status `new`, validates the email, asks Claude for a draft, saves it as `pending_approval`, and emails you.

parameters.subject: Outreach drafts ready for approval
parameters.message: ={{ $('A5 Parse and validate draft').all().filter(i => i.json.status === 'pending_approval').length }} drafts are ready in your Leads sheet ({{ $('A5 Parse and validate draft').all().filter(i => i.json.status === 'draft_error').length }} failed validation: see rows marked draft_error). Edit anything, then set status to "approved" on the ones to send. Sending starts at 10:30 IST.

parameters.content:
## FLOW B: SEND APPROVED
Weekdays 10:30 IST. Sends rows with status `approved`, up to CAP per day, one every 2.5 to 5.5 minutes, then marks them `sent`. Rows that fail a safety check or fail to send become `needs_fix`.

## FLOW C: FOLLOW-UP DRAFTS
Weekdays 09:15 IST. For rows with status `sent` for 5+ days and no reply, Claude drafts a short follow-up (max 10 per run). You approve with `fu_approved`.

parameters.subject: Follow-up drafts ready for approval
parameters.message: ={{ $('C5 Parse and validate follow-up').all().filter(i => i.json.ok).length }} follow-up drafts are ready. Review the fu_body column and set status to "fu_approved" on the ones to send. They go out at 13:00 IST.

parameters.content:
## FLOW D: SEND FOLLOW-UPS
Weekdays 13:00 IST. Sends rows with status `fu_approved` as a reply in the same Gmail thread, up to CAP per day, then marks `followup_sent`.

## FLOW E: REPLY AND BOUNCE DETECTOR
Checks your inbox every 10 minutes. A reply in a thread you started (or from a lead's address) sets `replied`, which stops follow-ups. A delivery-failure notice sets `bounced`. Out-of-office auto-replies are ignored.
